result.document_summary: A portion of the San Diego Municipal Code (cannabis business tax administration provisions, §§ 34.0116-34.0128) retrieved from a page URL titled for the algorithmic rent-price-fixing division, but containing no rental housing rules.
result.notes: This part contains only San Diego cannabis business tax administration provisions (assessment, appeals, refunds, liens, successor liability, criminal violations). None of it concerns rent increase limits, just-cause eviction, security deposits, screening fees, screening restrictions, or algorithmic rent setting. The URL and page title refer to a San Diego ban on algorithmic rent-price-fixing (§ 98.1103), but the algorithmic-device text itself does not appear in this part, so no rule is extracted.
